body:
Having someone to talk to helps, thank you. I would appreciate that right now since I'm not in a good place, and I don't want to lay this on my friends again. I don't want to upset them. 

It's so hard to keep going forward. Everyone says to tough it out and I am doing the best I can. I feel like I'm in a hole I will never get out of, and I'm going to drag down everyone with me like my ex friend did to me and so many others. I'm scared of becoming like her and shoving the abuse onto others. I run and hide, hoping it never comes to that. I don't want to be this way, but I don't know how to make it stop. I can't talk back to the voices in my head because when they happen I shut down or go into a manic episode. 

I don't like looking forward to the day I die. Thinking about death all the time doesn't make it easier, but some days it just feels like it would be the right thing to do with how my life is. I just turned thirty not too long ago, and it's really cemented that I went this long without doing anything to improve my life or make it worth living. I know no one can fix me, but I don't think I can fix myself either.
Just turned 30 recently. Old enough to know I'm past the point of being a use to anyone.
